title: Erlang/OTP stdlib Source (curated selection)
licence_verified_from: erlang/otp LICENSE.txt, read via GitHub connector (full Apache 2.0 text)
notes: Curated real Erlang teaching the language and OTP behaviours: gen_server, gen_statem, supervisor, gen_event, lists, string, ets, maps, queue, sets, gb_trees, io_lib. Code unmodified. Left out for the ~1.1M budget: erl_lint, qlc, rand, dets, sofs, erl_eval, erl_scan, epp, shell, argparse, unicode, io, filename, calendar, dict/orddict/ordsets, re, zip, erl_tar, and the rest of lib/stdlib/src (96 .erl files total).
